findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "stack_pains" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user wants an aggregate of which tools people use for a category, what they complain about, what else they consider, and what makes them switc…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_buying_intent, weekly_brief, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: find_buyer_signals, stack_pains, find_buying_intent · Public sink: find_buying_intent, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_buying_intent, weekly_brief, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: find_buyer_signals, stack_pains, find_buying_intent · Public sink: find_buying_intent, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
